payload.tension: The passage states a collection is arranged for Jerusalem. Now about the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise. If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
